adaface_ir101.preprocessing: 112x112 aligned crop; BGR (no swap); NCHW float32; (x-127.5)/127.5; embedding L2-normed by the net, caller re-L2-normalizes
adaface_ir101.note: Exported locally from the PyTorch checkpoint; no official ONNX exists.

lvface_base.preprocessing: 112x112 aligned crop; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32; (x-127.5)/127.5; raw embedding, caller L2-normalizes

lvface_large.preprocessing: 112x112 aligned crop; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32; (x-127.5)/127.5; raw embedding, caller L2-normalizes

lvface_small.preprocessing: 112x112 aligned crop; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32; (x-127.5)/127.5; raw embedding, caller L2-normalizes

lvface_tiny.preprocessing: 112x112 aligned crop; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32; (x-127.5)/127.5; raw embedding, caller L2-normalizes

yolov12l-face.preprocessing: letterbox to 640x640; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32 in [0,1]; NMS-baked detection output (1, M, 6): [x1,y1,x2,y2,score,class] (no landmarks — detection A/B only)
yolov12l-face.license_note: Same akanametov/yolo-face 1.0.0 release + AGPL-3.0 terms as yolov8n-face; LOCAL benchmark tooling only, never bundled into the distributed app.
yolov12l-face.note: Pre-exported ONNX downloaded directly from the release (checksum-verified). The akanametov *large* face variants are plain detect models, not pose models, so this head emits (1, M, 6) with NO landmark columns; the adapter (yoloface.py) auto-detects the K=0 layout and emits NaN landmarks, so it drives detection recall (detect_compare.py) only — it cannot feed the alignment/recognition path.

yolov8l-face.preprocessing: letterbox to 640x640; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32 in [0,1]; NMS-baked detection output (1, M, 6): [x1,y1,x2,y2,score,class] (no landmarks — detection A/B only)
yolov8l-face.license_note: Same weights family/license as yolov8n-face (akanametov/yolo-face 1.0.0, AGPL-3.0); LOCAL benchmark tooling only, never bundled into the distributed app.
yolov8l-face.note: The release ships yolov8l-face only as a .pt (no pre-exported .onnx), and it is a plain detect model with no landmark head. One-time export in a SCRATCH venv (never the project venv): pip install ultralytics onnxslim; python -c "from ultralytics import YOLO; YOLO('yolov8l-face.pt').export(format='onnx', opset=12, imgsz=640, nms=True, simplify=True)" then place the .onnx at the local_path above. The .pt is the akanametov 1.0.0 release asset yolov8l-face.pt (164.8 GFLOPs). Output is (1, M, 6) with NO landmarks; drives detection recall (detect_compare.py) only, not recognition.

yolov8n-face.preprocessing: letterbox to 640x640; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32 in [0,1]; NMS-baked output (1, M, 6+3K): [x1,y1,x2,y2,score,class,(x,y,vis)*5]
yolov8n-face.license_note: Ultralytics-derived YOLOv8 weights trained on WIDERFACE (akanametov/yolo-face 1.0.0 release). AGPL-3.0 is acceptable for this LOCAL, non-shipped benchmark tooling only; the weights are NOT bundled into the distributed app. Do not redistribute inside a proprietary product.
yolov8n-face.note: Pre-exported ONNX with NMS baked in; onnxruntime-only, no torch. The adapter (yoloface.py) auto-detects this layout and only confidence-filters (NMS already applied). Emits 5-point facial landmarks in SCRFD order (norm_crop-compatible).

yolov8n-face-raw.preprocessing: letterbox to 640x640; BGR->RGB; NCHW float32 in [0,1]; raw YOLOv8-pose head (1, 4+nc+3K, N), pre-NMS
yolov8n-face-raw.license_note: Same weights/license as yolov8n-face; differs only in the ONNX export (no baked NMS).
yolov8n-face-raw.note: Produced offline (exercises the adapter's own NMS path); not auto-downloadable. One-time export in a SCRATCH venv (never the project venv): pip install ultralytics; python -c "from ultralytics import YOLO; YOLO('yolov8n-face.pt').export(format='onnx', opset=12, imgsz=640, nms=False, simplify=True)" then place the .onnx at the local_path above. The .pt is the akanametov 1.0.0 release asset yolov8n-face.pt.
